matrix_title: Gnomish Factory Primitives vs Omnivore Primitives Reuse Matrix

transplant_matrix.omnivore_primitive: Atomic write + fsync in omnivore-master-reconcile, linear phase runner in research_fabric.py
transplant_matrix.status_comparison: Stronger in formal consistency & testability; weaker in streaming overhead
transplant_matrix.primary_advantage: Proves total crash-consistency with compile-time closed shapes and double-recovery idempotence tests
transplant_matrix.recommendation: Adopt in Research Fabric phase transitions

transplant_matrix.omnivore_primitive: External mutation guards (/usr/local/libexec/claude-worktree-mutation-guard) and root authority leases
transplant_matrix.status_comparison: Stronger in proactive partition safety; weaker in mid-step interruption
transplant_matrix.primary_advantage: Self-freezes mutations before writing when lease heartbeats decay, preventing split-brain writes
transplant_matrix.recommendation: Adopt in long-running toolbelt and subagent worker loops

transplant_matrix.omnivore_primitive: Monolithic omnivore-master-reconcile status check with coarse RED/NONRED buckets
transplant_matrix.status_comparison: Stronger in conflict elimination and bounded quarantine; weaker in setup verbosity
transplant_matrix.primary_advantage: Guarantees exactly one component converges each interrupted shape; eliminates background vs foreground recovery races
transplant_matrix.transplant_risk: Low (mapping table from artifact state to handler)
transplant_matrix.recommendation: Adopt in Omnivore reconcile and Auto Review error dispatch

transplant_matrix.omnivore_primitive: Host subprocess execution with setpriv drops or in-tree test scripts
transplant_matrix.status_comparison: Stronger in anti-tampering and forensic preservation; weaker in spin-up latency
transplant_matrix.primary_advantage: Proves branch self-sufficiency from commit pin; executes in-box egress/uid self-check; preserves rejected box for forensics
transplant_matrix.recommendation: Adopt commit-pin clean environment pattern for oracle courts

transplant_matrix.omnivore_primitive: Managed policy settings (/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json) and hook-based pretool enforcement
transplant_matrix.status_comparison: Stronger in privilege escalation prevention; weaker in ad-hoc operator overrides
transplant_matrix.primary_advantage: Asymmetric rule ensures untrusted task configs can only tighten requirements, never weaken bindings or limits
transplant_matrix.recommendation: Adopt in task/vault input validation to forbid disabling security controls

transplant_matrix.omnivore_primitive: Periodic cron/systemd cleanup scripts and one-off hygiene checks (SYSTEMD_HYGIENE_CURRENT.json)
transplant_matrix.status_comparison: Stronger in race elimination during garbage collection; weaker in write count
transplant_matrix.primary_advantage: Admission-first, removal-last ordering ensures no object falls outside sweeper universe during crash
transplant_matrix.recommendation: Adopt in run-directory allocation and scratch cleanup

rejected_candidates.reason: Overkill for Omnivore; would introduce complex multi-agent runner infrastructure that conflicts with native Teamwork and Research Fabric.
Inferior to Omnivore's local file locks and cryptographic receipts; rate-limited and subject to external provider downtime.
Weaker than Omnivore's strict signed-commit and SHA-256 evidence gates; violates byte-grounded proof principles.
